description: This file is a server-side module in a SvelteKit project, handling data fetching, processing, and CRUD actions for a Tasks list page in a frontend application. It interfaces with a Django REST API to perform task-related operations, including loading task data with filters, creating, updating, deleting, and moving tasks, supporting both list and kanban views.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load function that fetches tasks, related entities, and dropdown options from the API, applies filters, and transforms data for frontend use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of new tasks by submitting form data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating existing tasks with form data via API.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Marks a task as completed by updating its status.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a completed or closed task by setting its status to 'New'.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified task via API call.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Handles reordering or moving tasks within the list/kanban by updating their status and position.
